svg.title: Black Triangle with White
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, interpretive colours. Black right triangle and wide white diagonal panel; transparent outside support contours. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sfmoma.org/artwork/FC.310/; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
